issuing_body: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (厚生労働省) / Guidelines Drafting Group for AI R&D Utilization of Digital Data
covered_actors: 学術研究機関等 (academic research institutions)
prohibited_practices: 推奨されない仮名加工情報の取扱い (non-recommended handling of pseudonymized information, as described in section 3.4)
enforcement_authorities: 個人情報保護委員会 (Personal Information Protection Commission)
厚生労働省 (Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare)
implementation_notes: Guideline focuses on pseudonymized medical information (仮名加工情報) under Japan's Act on Protection of Personal Information for use in AI R&D and medical device product development. Excludes: clinical trial data, anonymous processing (匿名加工情報), cross-border data transfers, advanced privacy-enhancing technologies, generative AI legal risks, and the Next-Generation Medical Infrastructure Act (次世代医療基盤法). Practical procedures for creating pseudonymized data from diagnostic text, physiological function tests, medical images, genetic test data, and multimodal data are provided.
